title: Add pull-request creation and GitHub context
description: Let users open repository/branch/commit context in GitHub and create or open a pull request for a published branch using authorized GitHub APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository, branch, and commit actions open the correct GitHub destinations.
A pull request can be created only for a published branch with verified base/head and an explicit user action.
Permission denial, missing upstream, existing pull request, rate limits, and API errors have truthful recovery states.
Only the minimum GitHub App permission for this feature is documented and requested; no token enters the renderer or logs.

steps.description: Inspect GitHub PR API and current permission contracts
steps.details: PR creation uses server-held authorization and documents the separate pull-request write permission boundary.
Creation requires an authorized matching workspace, published clean branch, explicit title/body, and existing-PR detection.
Focused API coverage verifies server-only authorization and create response validation; workspace guards cover missing upstream and dirty/unpushed state.

technicalNotes: Pull requests are GitHub-hosted collaboration, not local Git state.
Never push, publish, or create a PR without explicit user authorization.
